title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Coliseum on 1973-03-15
source: Source: Soundboard > Reel Master > Cassette > DAT (48k)

ai_review.summary: Warm‑up show with a strong Truckin’ > The Other One > Eyes > Stella stretch, but plagued by dropouts and audience splices in the soundboard.
ai_review.review: The performance shines on the second‑set medley of Truckin’, The Other One, Eyes and Stella as well as a cathartic Playin’ in the Band, making it a worthwhile listen for fans despite being a warm‑up to the famed night after. Unfortunately the source is a badly compromised soundboard with numerous dropouts, volume anomalies and audience splices that force heavy editing, leaving the overall listening experience only fair.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewers praise several standout songs and a solid musical flow but consistently criticize severe recording defects; the weighted blend of decent show quality (≈3.5) and poor audio quality (≈2.0) yields an overall rating around 3.1.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Numerous dropouts, volume anomalies, and audience splices throughout; some sections were edited with fades to mask inconsistencies, but the mix remains uneven and occasionally muddy.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A warm‑up set that feels like a prelude to the legendary following night; the second set delivers strong momentum with the Truckin’/Other One/Eyes/Stella sequence, but missing portions of the first set and edited gaps disrupt overall continuity.
